verdict_text:
YES

The script verifies identical key sets and bit-equality of all non-MLP tensors before any writing, computes each task vector against the untouched `base` dict (`out` is a separate copy, so no ordering hazard), applies `base + 0.4*(ft1-base) + 0.4*(ft2-base)` in float32, and asserts `merged == 48` and `len(out) == 160` before saving to `out/T4/model.safetensors`.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm).
